shots.description: the core glowing in its glass case above the city; VEX's fist through the glass
VEX lifts the core out: the city's lights die in a wave; a warning beacon pulses
IKO and PELL turn; VEX shows them the core and laughs
the chase: over the plinth; VEX kicks a crate back at them, IKO ducks, PELL rolls
over the gap, the vent vaulted, flat out across the roofs
the flying kick launched too far; VEX steps out of it and kicks IKO to the edge; PELL waved on
the chase goes on, through the gate to the storm tower
out of the white: low on the storm tower, VEX leaping up the girders with the core
IKO climbs after him, flips across the gap
the girder fight: IKO drives, VEX gives ground on his guard
IKO cheers too soon; the roundhouse dodged; the sweep
IKO cannot get up; VEX looks down at him, laughs, and goes
PELL's hand; IKO takes it; PELL points the way
after him together
out of the white: the canyon at sunset; VEX over the rope bridge
he kicks out the stake: the bridge falls into the canyon in front of IKO
IKO leaps for the orb: it flips him across the gap
PELL jumps short, catches the edge, hauls himself up and slides under the swinging beam
the drone shrugs off IKO's kick; PELL's X tears it apart; IKO rolls through
into the portal after VEX
out of the white: a floating arena; VEX carries the core to the socket
the core set in the socket: energy floods the arena
VEX takes up the staff: IKO's jab blocked, the swing slipped, the side kick lands
PELL rushes in, too late: the staff knocks IKO down; he cannot get up
PELL's throw takes the staff out of VEX's hands
IKO up; a look at PELL; he ducks VEX's hook and the flying kick lands
VEX cannot rise; IKO takes the core back out of the socket
out together, the core in IKO's hands
out of the white: dawn; IKO and PELL run up with the core, worn out
IKO sets the core in the beacon
a pulse of light: far below, the city lights up again
IKO looks at PELL; a fist bump, earned
the camera pulls back over the restored world: CORE RUN
